capabilities: Visualize wayfinder:map GitHub issues as dependency-layered ticket trees
Filter and navigate maps by repository, completion state, and ticket state
Show ticket details with descriptions, blockers, comments, and GitHub links
Copy /wayfinder commands for the next takeable ticket
Sync issue data on open, on focus, and on a configurable poll interval
disambiguation: Not a geographic mapping or navigation tool; 'maps' here are GitHub issues that group tickets into dependency trees.
extras: The README warns that the GitHub token is stored in plain text in the vault's plugin data.json, so anything syncing the vault exposes it; Plugin 1.x is aligned to the v1.1.0 wayfinder skills release.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view a GitHub repo's issues, their blocker relationships, and what is safe to pick up next without leaving the app.

requires.name: fine-grained personal access token with read-only Issues permission

summary: Plugin that renders a GitHub repo's wayfinder:map issues as head cards with tickets in dependency-layered trees, synced from GitHub inside Obsidian.
